video_caption: The black-and-white video segment opens in an office, featuring a large desk with a chess set, a lamp, and a statue. Initially, three men in dark military uniforms, two of whom wear Nazi armbands and peaked caps, escort a disheveled civilian man with a bandaged forehead into the room through a door. A different officer, wearing a light-colored military uniform with medals, stands by the desk; he addresses the group, after which the two uniformed escorts leave the civilian and exit through the door. The officer then gestures for the civilian, identified as Captain Thorndyke, to be seated, saying "Be seated, Captain Thorndyke." Captain Thorndyke, looking weary and resigned, walks slowly to the desk, and the officer gently guides him to the chair at the chess table before offering him a cigarette from his jacket pocket. A "thriller" watermark is visible in the bottom right corner of the screen from 0:15 to the end of the clip.

In a black-and-white indoor scene, a man in a dark jacket with a dark mark on his forehead is seated at a table with a chessboard and pieces, smoking a cigarette. Another man, dressed in a light-colored military uniform adorned with medals and insignia, stands over him. The standing man holds a lighter and extends it to light the seated man's cigarette. After lighting it, the seated man takes a drag, exhaling a plume of smoke, and then looks up at the standing man, who appears to be speaking to him. The setting suggests a formal or intense conversation, possibly an interrogation or a significant meeting, with a window and dark curtains visible on the left side of the frame.

In a dimly lit room with elegant dark curtains and a large window showcasing a snowy mountain view, two men engage in a tense interaction. One man, dressed in a pristine light-colored military uniform complete with medals, a dark tie, and a sidearm, stands confidently, holding a small, dark object in his hands. He gestures with his hands as he speaks, at one point turning his back to the seated man and looking out the window before returning his attention to him. The second man, wearing a dark jacket and tie with a patterned texture, sits opposite him at an octagonal table where a chessboard is laid out with pieces. He has a bandage on his forehead, and his demeanor shifts from looking up intently at the standing man to appearing pensive, touching his face, and eventually lighting a cigarette, taking a drag, and looking upwards thoughtfully. The scene is shot in black and white, emphasizing the dramatic and serious tone of the conversation.

The video segment, presented in black and white, opens in a dimly lit, stately room where a man in a light-colored military uniform with insignia stands near a small table, gesturing towards another man seated opposite him. A chess set is visible on the small table, and a large wooden desk is in the background. The uniformed man then turns and walks away from the seated man, his hands clasped behind his back, passing the long wooden desk adorned with what appears to be a sword or saber and other objects. He continues to walk across the room, eventually stopping in front of a grand fireplace, which is flanked by two ornate, dark wooden chairs and tall candelabras, with a large, dark framed painting hanging above it. Interspersed with these shots of the uniformed man, the other man is shown seated in a chair, wearing a dark jacket and tie, with a bandage on his forehead, thoughtfully smoking a cigarette. He is positioned by a large window that offers a striking view of majestic, possibly snow-capped, mountains under a cloudy sky. The video cuts back and forth between the uniformed man standing formally in the large room and the seated man smoking by the scenic window. A "UNIVERSAL MAX" watermark is faintly visible in the bottom right corner during some of the scenes with the seated man.

In a black and white film scene, a man in a light-colored military uniform with medals and a dark tie stands in a dimly lit room, gesturing with his hand as he speaks. He initially faces a second man, dressed in a dark jacket and light trousers, who is seated in a large armchair, listening intently. A chessboard with pieces is on a table between them, and a lamp with a patterned shade stands next to the seated man. Behind the seated man, a large window reveals a dramatic mountainous landscape under a cloudy sky. The man in uniform walks around, then sits on a desk, revealing a monocle in his right eye and a serious expression. The seated man then begins to speak, holding a lit cigarette that emits a steady stream of smoke, and he has a confident, almost smirking expression. The camera cuts between the serious, monocled man in uniform and the smoking, confident seated man, who occasionally gestures with his free hand. Throughout the video, a "thriller MAX" watermark is visible in the bottom right corner.

The black and white video shows a conversation between two men in an indoor setting, likely an office, with a large window overlooking mountains. One man, wearing a dark jacket and tie with a bandage on his forehead, is seated at a desk, smoking a cigarette, and gesturing animatedly as he speaks, expressing that the sport of hunting is about the chase, not the kill. The other man, dressed in a light-colored military uniform with medals and a monocle, initially appears serious and then points assertively, stating, "That's it. Precisely. The most dangerous of all animals, man." The man in the jacket counters, "But you don't kill... The sport is in the chase, not the kill." The uniformed man listens, occasionally smiling subtly, and then stands with his hands behind his back, seemingly pleased with his statement, while the man in the jacket continues to articulate his perspective on hunting as a challenge of wits rather than cruelty.

The video begins with a medium shot of a man in a light-colored military uniform, facing slightly right with his hands clasped behind his back, his mouth moving as if speaking. He has short, dark hair and a focused expression. His uniform includes a jacket with four pockets, epaulets, and multiple medals or insignia on his left chest and lapel. The background is dark and indistinct. At 0:02, the scene cuts to a wider shot of the same room. The uniformed man is now seen from behind, still standing with his hands clasped, facing a man seated in a dark suit and tie. The seated man holds a lit cigarette between his fingers, looking at the uniformed man. A chessboard with pieces is placed on a dark wooden table between them. Beyond the men, large, multi-paned windows reveal a dramatic, rugged mountain landscape, suggesting a high-altitude setting. Dark curtains flank the windows on the right side of the frame. A "THRILLER MAX" watermark is visible in the bottom right corner throughout the segment.

The video segment, presented in black and white, opens with a man in a light-colored military uniform standing by a large window overlooking a mountainous landscape. He is facing away from the camera, addressing another man seated in a chair to the right, who wears a dark jacket and tie and has a bandage on his forehead. A chessboard with pieces is on a small table between them. The man in uniform then turns and walks towards a large wooden desk on the left. Another man in a dark uniform briefly enters, salutes the man in the light uniform, who returns the salute, and they exchange a small document. The man in the dark uniform then exits the room. The man in the light uniform places the document on the desk, then picks up another larger document and begins to read it, walking back towards the seated man. He speaks to the seated man, holding the document, and states that he can leave the country a free man and return to his position and friends, despite what he's done. The seated man, looking up, asks, "On what condition?" The man in the light uniform replies, "Your name signed to this." He adds that it will be witnessed by the chief of secret police and other officials. The camera then focuses on the seated man, who, with a slight smirk, asks, "What is it, a suicide note?" The segment concludes with a close-up of the man in the light uniform, looking down at the document with a somber expression.

The video segment opens with a man in a light-colored German military uniform, adorned with medals and an eagle insignia, standing with a serious expression, looking down. He is in what appears to be an office with a dark background and a classical-style statue visible to his left. He speaks of an attempted assassination of their "Fuhrer" on July 20th, 1939. The scene then cuts to a different man, wearing a dark jacket over a lighter sweater and tie, with a bandage on his forehead, sitting and looking distressed before looking up in disbelief. The segment transitions to a wider shot showing both men standing, facing each other. The military officer holds a document and interrogates the other man, who vehemently denies the accusations, stating, "I can't believe you're serious." He refutes the claim of intending to shoot, asserting it was a "sporting stalk," and when asked why he didn't leave his rifle behind, he concludes, "it wouldn't have been sporting." The background reveals a dark wooden desk with a decanter and a floor lamp, with the same statue behind the men. A "thriller channel" watermark is present in the bottom right corner of the screen throughout the video.

In a black and white video segment, two men are engaged in a heated discussion. The man on the left, dressed in a light-colored military uniform adorned with medals and insignia, holds what appears to be a cigarette or a slim stick, listening intently with a subtle smile. The man on the right, wearing a dark jacket over a sweater and riding breeches, with a bandage on his forehead, speaks animatedly, using hand gestures to emphasize his points. He seems passionate and slightly disheveled. The background is a dimly lit room with a sculpture and a lamp. As the conversation progresses, the man on the right turns away, looking towards a window, then back at the uniformed man, while the uniformed man turns to face the front, removing the stick from his hand. Suddenly, a door opens, and two men in dark military-style uniforms, complete with peaked caps and armbands, enter the room and position themselves on either side of the bandaged man. The uniformed officer on the left then begins to walk slowly towards the center of the room as the bandaged man watches him. A "thrilleror" watermark is visible in the bottom right corner of the screen throughout the clip.

In a black and white scene, a stern-faced man in a military uniform with a monocle attached to his right eye engages in a tense conversation with another man, who has a bandage on his forehead, wears a dark shirt and tie, and appears worn. The military officer is seen speaking, with his face in profile for much of the shot, while the bandaged man listens attentively, his expression reflecting concern or resignation. The background is dimly lit, with abstract shapes suggesting furniture or decor. A faint "thriller FOX" watermark is visible in the bottom right corner of the screen. The scene then transitions to a wider shot, showing the military officer standing in a room as the bandaged man is escorted out through a doorway by two other men in dark uniforms and caps. The door closes behind them, leaving the military officer alone in the room, watching them leave.
